principalMessage.name: Dr. A. P. Bhat
text: Welcome to Poornaprajna College, an institution conceived under the divine vision of H.H. Sri Vibhudhesha Theertha Swamiji of Sri Admar Mutt. Since our foundation in 1960, we have stood as a beacon of academic rigor and moral uprightness in coastal Karnataka.

As an autonomous institution affiliated with Mangalore University, we enjoy the curricular freedom to formulate industry-aligned syllabi, foster undergraduate research, and cultivate critical thinking. Our legacy of producing university rank-holders, entrepreneurs, civil servants, and scholars across six decades is a testament to our steadfast pursuit of quality.
I invite aspiring students to step into our vibrant campus at Volakadu and embark on an enriching voyage of intellect, ethics, and innovation.

aboutSummary: Poornaprajna College (Autonomous), Udupi was founded in the year 1960 by the visionary seer of Sri Admar Mutt, His Holiness Sri Vibhudhesha Theertha Swamiji, whose pioneering objective was to harmonize ancient Indian values of scholarship and integrity with contemporary scientific enquiry.

Managed by the Sri Admar Mutt Education Council (AMEC), the college has blossomed from modest beginnings into a premier institution of higher learning in Karnataka. With state-of-the-art laboratories, a heritage central library housing rare palm-leaf manuscripts and tens of thousands of academic volumes, and an autonomous curriculum designed to meet modern societal and industrial expectations, Poornaprajna remains committed to total student development.

courses.title: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.)
courses.eligibility: Candidates who have passed the Karnataka 2nd PUC examination or Senior Secondary (10+2 / CBSE / ICSE) examination with Commerce / Science / Arts combinations.
courses.feeInfo: Concession and fee structures administered as per Autonomous Institution norms. Detailed fee schedule available at the college administrative office.
courses.description: The B.Com programme at Poornaprajna College is one of the most prestigious in coastal Karnataka, providing profound knowledge in Financial Accounting, Corporate Law, Direct & Indirect Taxes, Auditing, and Financial Management.
curriculumOverview: Direct Tax Law & Goods and Services Tax (GST) Practice
careerOpportunities: Chartered Accountancy (CA) / Company Secretary (CS) / CMA preparation

faqs.question: Is Poornaprajna College B.Com autonomous?
faqs.answer: Yes, Poornaprajna College is an autonomous institution affiliated with Mangalore University, granting syllabus design flexibility and modern evaluation systems.

faqs.question: Does the department offer CA foundation coaching?
faqs.answer: The department coordinates dedicated CA/CS Foundation guidance classes through visiting professionals and alumni mentors.

courses.title: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.)
courses.eligibility: Candidates who have passed Karnataka 2nd PUC or 10+2 equivalent with Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics / Biology.
courses.feeInfo: Concession as per institutional and state norms. Exact laboratory and fee breakdown available at the administrative counter.
courses.description: A foundational sciences programme with cutting-edge experimental laboratories in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Botany, Zoology, and Computer Science.
curriculumOverview: Calculus, Differential Equations, Linear Algebra & Numerical Analysis
Plant Physiology, Microbiology, Animal Taxonomy & Ecology
subjects: Physics Practical & Theory (Mechanics, Electromagnetism, Quantum Physics)
careerOpportunities: IT Software Development & Data Analysis (PMC stream)
higherStudyOptions: M.Sc. in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biotechnology
Integrated Ph.D. at premier national institutes (IISc, IITs, TIFR)

faqs.question: Are laboratory facilities well equipped?
faqs.answer: The college maintains spacious, autonomous science laboratories with advanced optical, chemical, and computational equipment.

courses.title: Bachelor of Computer Applications (B.C.A.)
courses.eligibility: Passed Karnataka 2nd PUC or 10+2 in Science, Commerce or Arts with Mathematics / Statistics / Computer Science or equivalent proficiency.
courses.feeInfo: Fee details provided through the admissions office.
courses.description: A technology-intensive curriculum emphasizing software engineering, web architectures, mobile app creation, database systems, and modern full-stack methodologies.
curriculumOverview: Problem Solving with C, C++, Java, and Python
Data Structures, Algorithms & Object-Oriented System Design
Web Technologies, Full-Stack Development & Cloud Concepts
Computer Networks, Cybersecurity, and Software Engineering

faqs.question: Does the BCA program include a major project?
faqs.answer: Yes, final year students develop real-world software applications under departmental faculty mentorship.

courses.title: Bachelor of Business Administration (B.B.A.)
courses.eligibility: Passed Karnataka 2nd PUC or 10+2 from any recognized board in any stream.
courses.feeInfo: Administered as per autonomous institution policies.
courses.description: Designed to nurture managerial competence, entrepreneurial leadership, marketing strategy, human resource dynamics, and supply chain fundamentals.

faqs.question: Are internships mandatory in BBA?
faqs.answer: Yes, students undertake an industry internship and institutional project report in their final year.

courses.title: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.)
courses.eligibility: Passed Karnataka 2nd PUC or equivalent 10+2 examination in Arts, Science or Commerce.
courses.feeInfo: Concession schemes and fees as approved by the college authority.
courses.description: A rich interdisciplinary program cultivating critical humanities perspective, historical enquiry, socio-economic analysis, and linguistic mastery.
curriculumOverview: History of India, Regional Karnataka History, and Modern World
Micro & Macro Economics, Development Economics, Indian Economy
Political Theory, Indian Constitution, Public Administration
Literary Studies in English & Kannada, Classical & Contemporary Texts
Sociology, Social Research, and Rural Development
careerOpportunities: Public Policy, NGO & Social Sector Leadership
higherStudyOptions: M.A. in Economics, History, English, Political Science, Kannada
Master of Social Work (MSW) / Public Administration (MPA)

faqs.question: Is there civil service coaching available?
faqs.answer: The college operates a dedicated Career Guidance & Competitive Examinations Cell that provides periodic seminars for UPSC and KPSC aspirants.

courses.title: Master of Commerce (M.Com.)
courses.eligibility: B.Com / B.B.A. graduates from a recognized university with minimum 45% aggregate marks (40% for SC/ST/Category-I).
courses.feeInfo: Administered as per PG autonomous guidelines. Schedule available at office.
courses.description: An advanced postgraduate program fostering analytical mastery of capital markets, international corporate finance, strategic taxation, and business research methodology.
curriculumOverview: Corporate Tax Planning & Indirect Tax Policies
careerOpportunities: Senior Financial Analyst / Equity Research Associate

faqs.question: Is a master's dissertation compulsory?
faqs.answer: Yes, every M.Com student writes a guided research dissertation on an empirical business or financial problem.

courses.title: M.Sc. in Mathematics
courses.eligibility: B.Sc. graduates with Mathematics as a major/cognate subject from a recognized university with minimum 45% marks (40% for SC/ST/Category-I).
courses.feeInfo: Contact PG office for official fee breakup.
courses.description: A prestigious PG programme in pure and applied mathematical science, developing mastery in algebra, topology, differential manifolds, graph theory, and computational mathematics.
curriculumOverview: Graph Theory, Operations Research, and PG Project
higherStudyOptions: Ph.D. in Mathematics at IISc, TIFR, IMSc, CMI, IITs

faqs.question: Are there CSIR-NET coaching sessions?
faqs.answer: The department conducts regular problem-solving workshops and NET coaching sessions for postgraduates.

departments.name: Department of Commerce
departments.hodMessage: Our mission is to sculpt ethically sound, technically adept commerce professionals who steer corporate India and financial institutions with integrity.
departments.overview: Established alongside the college in 1960, the Department of Commerce is the cornerstone of academic achievement at Poornaprajna, consistently achieving stellar university outcomes and active industry engagement.

departments.hodMessage: We foster an empirical spirit, training minds to observe, hypothesize, test, and innovate for sustainable societal advancement.
departments.overview: Encompassing spacious laboratories in Physics, Chemistry, Botany, and Zoology, the Science faculty is recognized for its undergraduate research culture and experiential learning.
researchAreas: Medicinal Plant Flora of Western Ghats
Aquatic Biodiversity in Udupi Coastal Belt

departments.name: Department of Computer Science & Applications
departments.hodMessage: Bridging algorithmic rigor with modern software engineering paradigms to produce competent builders of modern digital systems.
departments.overview: Equipped with modern networked computing systems, high-speed fiber-optic connectivity, and licensed development toolchains, serving both BCA and B.Sc. (PMC) students.

departments.name: Department of Business Administration
departments.hodMessage: Developing agile leaders who combine entrepreneurial vigor with ethical organizational values.
departments.overview: Focusing on executive case studies, management fests, startup incubation seminars, and corporate internships.

departments.name: Faculty of Humanities & Social Sciences
departments.hodMessage: Nurturing humanist empathy, cultural appreciation, and rigorous civic analysis in an evolving world.
departments.overview: Houses distinguished departments of Economics, History, Political Science, English, Kannada, and Sanskrit, with deep roots in regional heritage.

departments.name: Postgraduate Department of Mathematics
departments.hodMessage: Unlocking the beauty and power of mathematical abstraction for pure scholarship and computational applications.
departments.overview: A vibrant center for mathematical study offering both undergraduate mathematics courses and the premier M.Sc. Mathematics programme.

alumni.testimonial: The rigorous scientific discipline and foundational physics lab training at Poornaprajna laid the bedrock for my research career. Sri Swamiji's vision lives on in every corridor.
Poornaprajna Department of Commerce gave me not just accounting concepts, but the ethics of accountability. Proud to be an alumna of this venerable autonomous college.
